en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a tree‑lined road curving along a hillside in spring, with flowering trees in full bloom on the right and a stone or concrete railing along the edge. On the left, a narrow road climbs uphill toward a large hilltop complex that looks like a castle or fortified manor, partly obscured by mist. A horse‑drawn carriage with two horses travels along the main road, and a lone pedestrian walks up the steep side road in the distance. The image has an old photographic look with some surface wear, vignetting, and high contrast typical of early 20th‑century prints.
